Port Hope Surroudings is a Cyclopedia area that can be discovered. Same as with other areas, there is a huge area to be walked and comprises a lot of hunting spawns, however, not all hunting places are included in the territory that needs to be discovered, so, as always you are discovering an area, you have to pay a lot of atenttion to avoid searching in long underground caves that are not even included.

This subarea has a peculiar problem, as almost half of the ground floor is covered in dense vegetation, making the advance very slow and almost impossible to follow a straight line. If you try to find the points of interest covering the terrain by following a grid, the vegetation will be a major obstacle, so you will have to pass several times over the same spot while trying to avoid missing some parts of the surface.


The hunting spots and places included in the subarea area are listed here:

  • Tiquanda Bandit Caves
  • Reptile and Crustacean Caves
  • Tarantula Caves
  • Tiquanda Laboratory
  • Water Elemental Cave (The one with level 50 requirement door and only mantassins).
  • Tunnel to deeper Banuta. (32854, 32670, 7)
  • Small hill with single wyvern. (32843, 32629, 7)
  • Small Carniphila Cave. (32906, 32736, 7)
  • Single hydra cave. (32945, 32702, 7)

The hunting spots NOT INCLUDED included in the subarea area are listed here

  • Port Hope Swamp Trolls.
  • Haunted Temple.
  • Carnivora's Rocks.
  • Spider Caves.
  • Trapwood see note below.
  • Banuta.
  • Chor.
  • Asura Palace.
  • Medusa Tower.
  • Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs entered through Tiquanda.
  • Tiquanda Dwarf Mine.
  • Tiquanda Corym Cave.
  • Terramite Caves
  • Water Elemental Dungeon (The one with lots of quara scouts and 2nd underwater floor with massive water elementals).
  • Mountain pass between Tiquanda and Southern Darama Desert. (32981, 32716, 7)
  • The small mountain pass on the old way to Chor. (33005, 32752, 7)

The following place is unconfirmed as part of the subarea.

  • A very small underground cave (32870, 32670, 8)

Notes:

  • There is a connection between the Tiquanda Bandit caves and the Swamp Troll caves at floor -2, be aware when the server log tells you left the subarea to avoid unnecesary time waste.
  • The tunnel to deeper Banuta belongs to the subarea up till the teleporter on the right side of the wall with the statue you use The Egg of The Many on.
  • The small buildings on surface of the Haunted Temple and the Carnivora's Rock are not included.
  • The northern coast of Banuta is included on this subarea (easy to see while highlighting the area on the cyclopedia).
  • The whole area of surface of Trapwood is included, but the underground complex is not.
